from_notes: - **Adjournment motion conditions**: definite, factual, urgent, of public importance; **one matter** only; **specific matter of recent occurrence**; **must not raise a question of privilege**; not revive a matter discussed in the session; not sub judice; **not more than one such motion at a sitting**; admissible only when other tools (e.g. short-duration discussion) would be too late. RAS 2018 (Rajasthan Assembly) → **I, III and IV** (privilege statement wrong).
x: An adjournment motion needs the Speaker's consent, must be restricted to a specific matter of recent occurrence, and only one may be made at a sitting. It must not raise a question of privilege, so II is wrong: I, III and IV.
source: Laxmikanth, Indian Polity 8th ed. p.350-354 (src/polity/laxmikanth-indian-polity-01.txt) p.352; Rocket Polity Sheets #29, #33 p.72-84 (src/polity/rocket-polity-01.txt)

from_notes: - **Guillotine** in loose exam wording = "approving bills / demands **without any discussion**" – not a walkout or a budget cut.
x: Guillotine is a closure: when the allotted time ends, all remaining clauses or demands are put to vote without further discussion. It is not a walkout or a budget cut.
source: Laxmikanth, Indian Polity 8th ed. p.350-354 (src/polity/laxmikanth-indian-polity-01.txt) p.351; PMF Polity 2 p.37-38 (src/polity/pmf-polity-02.txt)

from_notes: Guillotine | Allotted time over – all remaining clauses / demands, discussed or not, put to vote (in the Budget the Speaker puts all remaining demands to vote without discussion)
x: When the time for demands for grants ends, the Speaker puts all remaining demands to vote without discussion. This is the guillotine, not a calling attention, adjournment or special mention motion.
source: Laxmikanth, Indian Polity 8th ed. p.350-354 (src/polity/laxmikanth-indian-polity-01.txt) p.351, p.357

from_notes: Point of order | Raised when proceedings depart from the rules (written or unwritten) or the articles regulating business; no debate; Presiding Officer rules
x: A point of order is raised when the proceedings break the rules (written or unwritten) for conducting the business of the House. The Presiding Officer rules on it without debate.
source: Laxmikanth, Indian Polity 8th ed. p.350-354 (src/polity/laxmikanth-indian-polity-01.txt) p.353

from_notes: Closure motion | Cuts short the debate – stoppage of debate on a motion – and puts the matter to vote; four kinds
x: A closure motion cuts short, or stops, the debate on a motion and puts the matter to vote. It does not end the session or the day.
source: Laxmikanth, Indian Polity 8th ed. p.350-354 (src/polity/laxmikanth-indian-polity-01.txt) p.351
